translation: After rubbing for half a day, a lump surged up on the left shoulder, ran obliquely through below the right jaw, turned back and descended through the middle, and then the back of the head became congested. So I rubbed above the ear gate, and only then did it go up to the forehead and crown, turn back behind the head, and disperse through the jaw. It surged up continuously, as large as a cup; fortunately it flowed freely, and only then did I know it was the taiyang channel.
